newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: British sheep a gift to Christmas tree farmers.
newsitem.headline: British sheep a gift to Christmas tree farmers.

text.p: British sheep may be the answer to Austrian Christmas tree farmers' prayers.

Imported Shropshire sheep, unlike their Austrian cousins, nibble delicately around the precious pines while keeping forest floors tidy, Peter Kar of the Upper Austrian regional Farmer's Association told Reuters.

"Ordinary Austrian sheep gobble up the Christmas tree shoots along with everything else," he said, adding that demand for the discerning British sheep was growing fast. "We're going to have to start breeding them ourselves."
Austria sells some 1.5 million Christmas trees annually. About 80 percent of those come from local forests.
